modalities.evidence: Resting energy expenditure (REE) and respiratory quotient (RQ) were measured

output.population: 9 healthy, normal weight participants (7 women), recruited from the New Haven area
output.summary: Third study of a flavor-nutrient conditioning series pairing flavors with maltodextrin beverages of differing caloric content. Indirect calorimetry sessions measured energy expenditure, followed by conditioning and brain imaging.
